 GSLV-F18/NVS-03 MISSION
 GSLV-F18 is the 20 th flight of India’s Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle
 (GSLV).
 The GSLV-F18 vehicle will place NVS-03 satellite into a Geosynchronous Transfer
 Orbit. Launch is planned from the Second Launch Pad (SLP) at Satish Dhawan Space
 Centre, SHAR.
 NVS-03 is the Third Satellite in Next generation navigation satellite system
 envisaged for providing continuity of navigation services for IRNSS series. The
 satellite carries Indigenous Atomic clock, along with the procured Atomic
 clocks. It also includes L1 signal in addition to existing L5/S signals with
 Coverage over India land mass and a region extending 1500 km around Indian
 geopolitical boundary.
